catalogue.status: metadata coverage only; estimated species are not independent measurements

limitations: Output volume is published; beverage mass is not. Every stop uses an explicit 1 g/mL proxy.
Basket diameter 58 mm, height 26.5 mm and perforated diameter 54 mm are assumptions.
Two fixed PSD hypotheses use 10% or 30% fines by volume; neither was fitted to these data.
Each scenario has a 150 s numerical ceiling; failure to reach the mass proxy is reported.
Boulder medians 400/600 um are proxies near the source's espresso/lungo PSD peaks, not measured medians.
Schaerer PSDs are unreported; Dalla Corte nominal PSDs are applied to them as explicit proxies.
A generic medium washed Arabica is used. Pt80/Pt86 have no established mapping to the model roast index.
Source hardness is 4-6 dH; alkalinity, ionic composition and source pH are unreported. Registry water is a scenario.
SE/SL 90 C is boiler temperature; actual extraction temperature is unreported.
Published pH and TA were measured at 20 C; the current chemistry calculation references 25 C.
Coffee intrinsic pH/background buffer are estimated; pH/TA agreement cannot be an independent predictive pass.
Total solids are gravimetric residue, and esterified fatty acids are not identical to filtered TDS or total lipid.

warnings: Estimated acidity: unmeasured counterions and macromolecular buffering are closed with the supplied intrinsic coffee pH/background buffer; no sensory prediction
Gas/oil cup recoveries are supplied transfer proxies separate from dissolved extraction, cup TDS and EY; crema is a gas-volume proxy without foam stability
Aroma is closed-headspace equilibrium at 25 °C plus effective post-shot binding; water-threshold OAVs omit matrix effects, open-cup loss, mixture interactions and sensory intensity

build_warnings: Medium-roast washed Arabica: Composition priors are medium-roast Arabica values (Farah 2012 compilation, grade C).

Bean v2: process (washed) is recorded; no quantitative correction is applied to the tracked compounds. For example, dry processing changes reducing sugars in green coffee, not a demonstrated universal sucrose correction in roasted coffee (02 §4.2).
Bean v2: variety group is recorded without an invented composition multiplier. Arabica/Robusta share remains the quantitative species descriptor; variety-specific lot assays are unavailable.
Bean: about 2.9 mg/g of CO₂ is left in the grounds after 10 days (fresh-ground residual scaled by the Smrke 2018 degassing fits); it slows early flow by up to 13% (gas mapping estimated, grade D).

M2 chemistry: 55 catalogue compounds plus the legacy acids diagnostic and an unassigned-solids remainder; 8.55% of the dry dose remains chemically unassigned. Estimated class transport and composition are not 55 independent espresso measurements. The acids aggregate overlaps named acids and is excluded from TDS; lipid and gas phases are separate.

Bean v2: sealed storage changes estimated aroma inventories through a broad, uncalibrated whole-bean loss scenario. It does not alter measured caffeine, trigonelline or 5-CQA anchors, and aroma remaining in a bean is not the same as aroma reaching the cup.
Machine: no pump given; an ideal (profiling) pump follows the program.
Machine: no three-way valve assumed, so the water above the puck drips into the cup after the stop; set machine.vent_headspace to true if your machine vents the group.
Grinder: measured PSD method not given; taken as volume-weighted (as laser diffraction reports).
Puck prep: distribution, paper, screen and headspace effects rest on community data (grade D); their parameters are wide priors (03 §4).
Puck prep: distribution not given; assumed tapping only ("tap").

Wetting: trapped pore air reduces early permeability, relaxing over an estimated 34.9 s. The mobility law and its moisture-diffusion timescale are uncertain (grade D); they were not fitted to held-out shot times.
M2 pH uses an estimated intrinsic coffee pH/background-buffer closure at 25 C; chemistry does not establish taste, and water hardness does not impose an extraction multiplier.
Aroma headspace is a closed-cup equilibrium estimate; gas/oil recovery and crema are proxies, with no calibrated foam lifetime or open-cup evaporation.
Solver: a large run: up to 2.64e3 steps × 1.80e6 values = 4.74e9 (expect several seconds or more)
Solver: M2 pH/TA use ideal 25 °C speciation and an estimated intrinsic-pH/background-buffer charge closure; Ca/Mg do not multiply extraction
